subject: POC kickoff — working session slot proposal and ops readiness

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@helioslabs.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff & hands-on workshop — availability and ops requests

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Helios is ready to move into a short POC (routing policy + load testing) and we'd like to get a 3-hour hands-on kickoff on the calendar to:

- walk through our prompt sets and expected traffic patterns;
- confirm model selection + quantization tradeoffs;
- run a short load test (100-200 concurrent virtual users) against a staging endpoint; and
- lock fallback/tiering rules for production cutover.

Our first pass of availability (all times PT): Tue 5/25 9–12, Thu 5/27 13–16, or Tue 6/1 10–13. If none of those work, send a couple options and we can rebook.

I've attached a short network checklist and a 1-page list of the prompt templates we'll exercise. For the load test we expect 3ish prompt types: short Q/A, multi-turn chat (6–8 turns), and a reranking reroute.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should join (ops, runtime, product)? Also, is it possible to get a draft agenda and the test token instructions ahead of the session?

Thanks — look forward to getting this moving.

— Alex
Alex Chen | Head of Integrations, Helios Labs

Attachment: Helios-Prework-Network-Checklist.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

- a 3-hour working session agenda (we'll send within 24 hours);
- staging test tokens + sample request templates;
- an ops playbook for the fallback rules we propose during the session.

Adding a quick note on model selection and prework:

- For the prompt types Alex described, recommend we prep two variants: a 7B quantized variant for latency-sensitive flows and a 13B FP16 for quality checks. We'll plan test permutations in the agenda.
- I'll upload a short prompt checklist and a deck with recommended fallback thresholds (latency > 800ms -> fallback to smaller model; token-error-rate > 1% -> route to retry tier).

I'll draft the agenda and share the doc link in the next message. Karthik — can you confirm we have capacity to run a 15-minute sustained 200-concurrent user test on the staging cluster the week of 5/24? If not, suggest we reserve an extra slot on Tue 6/1.

— Marissa

Thanks — 13:30–16:30 PT on Thu 5/27 works for us. We prefer the session on 5/27 if Redwood can accommodate the slight shift.

I've attached our network contact details and a short signed NDA placeholder (for records) — see attachment. We'll also invite our platform engineer (Priya Shah) to the calendar after you confirm.
